page_title: GET 2-0 GRA | Getafe v Granada CF 29/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+7' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and David Soria makes a comfortable save.
90+6' Victor Garcia interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Enes Unal (Getafe).
90+5' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+5' The linesman signals that Enes Unal (Getafe) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+4' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+3' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Getafe.
90' Having seen unsporting behavior, Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Alexander Medina (Granada CF) is the recipient.
90' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) has too much to say to the referee and is cautioned.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Carles Alena (Getafe) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
89' Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Myrto Uzuni.
88' Alexander Medina has decided to make a change. Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF) replaces Carlos Neva.
87' Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) receives a yellow card.
86' David Soria leaps like a salmon to deny Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.

85' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
85' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
84' Granada CF will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
83' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF). Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick.
81' Substitution. Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) in, Yellu Santiago out.
80' A quickly taken corner by Granada CF.

79' A pass into the box finds Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by David Soria denies him. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick.
78' The ball is out of play. Granada CF will take a throw-in.
77' Getafe enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
76' The attendance is 10382.
74' Diego Rico (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
73' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
71' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe) replacing Jordi.
71' Substitution. Borja Mayoral makes way for Carles Alena (Getafe).
71' David Soria displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Matias Arezo (Granada CF) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
69' Surely that's handball by one of the Granada CF players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
68' Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar.
65' A great run by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
65' Omar Alderete (Getafe) is caught offside!
64' Victor Garcia has a clear sight and sees a foul from Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF).
63' Jaime Mata goes off the pitch and Enes Unal (Getafe) comes on.
63' A clever short pass gives Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
62' Diego Rico (Getafe) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman signals a throw-in for Getafe.
59' That's the end of the game for Gerard Gumbau, who is replaced by Oscar Melendo (Granada CF).
59' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post.
59' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) is going to take the penalty!
58' It’s a PENALTY to Granada CF after the VAR review!

56' Play continues despite the shouts by some Granada CF players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Victor Garcia interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
55' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the left post.
54' Jaime Mata (Getafe) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
53' Jaime Mata (Getafe) is penalised for a foul. Victor Garcia had a clear view and blows his whistle.
52' Jaime Mata (Getafe) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.

51' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
50' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
50' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
49' The ball is cleared after Mason Greenwood (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
47' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
47' Granada CF are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The ball has crossed the sideline. Getafe are taking a throw-in.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Flag goes up against Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
44' The foul by Jaime Mata (Getafe) was seen by Victor Garcia who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
43' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
43' Jaime Mata (Getafe) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
42' Looks like Jaime Mata (Getafe) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
40' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Granada CF will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
38' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) heads on.
36' 2 - 0 Goal! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Augusto Batalla and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 2:0.
34' Jordi (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
32' Jordi (Getafe) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
31' The ball is out of play. Getafe win a corner kick.
31' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
29' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) brings his opponent down. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece.
26' Great teamplay by Getafe as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
24' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
23' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

21' 1 - 0 GOAL 1:0! Mason Greenwood (Getafe) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
19' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.
18' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Jaime Mata (Getafe) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
17' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
16' Omar Alderete (Getafe) sends a long ball in, but Augusto Batalla comfortably gathers the ball.
13' Diego Rico (Getafe) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Victor Garcia ignores the protests.
13' Jordi (Getafe) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
11' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and it's Jaime Mata (Getafe) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

11' What a save from Augusto Batalla! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
10' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) is flagged for offside.
10' The ball goes out of play. Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
9' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
8' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
7' The linesman raises his flag. Jaime Mata (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
7' The corner is swung in but Granada CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
6' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Getafe.
4' Diego Rico (Getafe) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
3' Neat passing move from Getafe in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The ball is behind the touchline and Getafe will take a throw-in.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Granada CF will take the kick-off.
